in_marathi.name: Torun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Torun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Torun is a Sanskrit word derived from the term 'tora', which means 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred and are believed to be the abode of gods and goddesses. The name Torun symbolizes strength, courage, and a deep connection to nature.
